failure_policy: save failure and completed job hashes; resume exact same code/input/config only
inference_status: descriptive paired losses only; no new nominal coverage claim
numerical_gates: unchanged fit_past multistart gates; no silent retry or dropping failed years
rating_policy: adopted_Q5_cumulative; pre-date updates already computed, no rating replay in this stage
refit: annual; whole preceding calendar-year windows; only actual prior outcomes are labels
selection: minimum pooled preceding-year loss_sum; exact ties cumulative then longer window
